title: +FOUNDATIONS OF OUTDOOR AND ADVENTURE PROFESSIONS
description: Explores the practical and conceptual aspects of outdoor tourism, adventure, and educational careers. Examines the history, evolution, and theoretical underpinning of outdoor and adventure professions including issues of diversity, accessibility and inclusion. Develops skills and strategies towards professional development and career planning.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: CORE 100*, 300*, BA 100*, 300*, ED 100*, 300*, LA 100*, 300*, SCI 100*, 300*, ENGR 110*, 110H*, 310* or minimum score of 1 in 'Baccalaureate Core Student'.
* May be taken concurrently.
A minimum grade of D- is required in CORE 100, CORE 300, BA 100, BA 300, ED 100, ED 300, LA 100, LA 300, SCI 100, SCI 300, ENGR 110, ENGR 110H and ENGR 310.
attribute_description: Core Education - Beyond OSU I, Career Preparation (CSC1)
books_html: No-cost: Course utilizes open educational resources, materials available through the library, or does not require any purchased materials.
meeting_html: TR 10am-11:20am in RICH 313 - Richardson Hall 313 (9/23 to 12/4)
